truths.statement: Deployment isolates code releases under /opt/ides and persistent data under /var/lib/ides. Root-only production environment provides the token.
Structured architecture, browser evidence and graph benchmark are in docs. Deployment status is tracked separately from development completion.
Git text files use LF so source archives execute correctly on Linux even when built on Windows.
